scope: SquashFS to ext4 pseudo-filesystem mount movement and forward pivot
Exec failure reverse pivot, moved/owned mount restoration, read-only original root before vendor exec
Root-owned real intermediate directories on generation and native init execution path
Child spawn signal mask and timeout reaping

resolved_findings.finding: Blocking waitpid after timeout SIGKILL could hang forever on uninterruptible fsck IO
resolved_findings.resolution: 40 bounded WNOHANG reap attempts then CHILD_REAP_DEFERRED and fallback return

resolved_findings.finding: Native root inode and intermediate init path directories were not checked; parent symlinks could differ across outside/chroot path resolution
resolved_findings.resolution: Checks NEWROOT/etc/leon before reading generation, and trusted_init_path walks every component before final regular root-owned executable

notes: Reverse restoration moves run/dev/sys/proc back before pivot_root onto the old SquashFS, then unmounts only tracked ext4 and pseudo mounts. It does not lazy-detach or claim recovered if restore fails.
After successful systemd exec, later boot failure remains the separate board trial/watchdog health mechanism; the bootstrap cannot auto-reverse a successful exec.
No QEMU or real hardware acceptance is claimed by this static peer review; parent owns those exact-binary fixtures.
